text:
Ava Li: Quick ask — need a launch "trajectory" comms pack for the upcoming benchmark webinar. One hero banner (animated spinner), three email tile sizes, and a condensed diagram that shows how inbound leads flow from webinar -> demo -> trial. Simple, brand-first, accessibility-friendly. Deadline: next Tue EOD.

Marco Reyes: Got it. Spinner — do you want full SVG animation or a GIF/mp4 fallback for email? Also which dimensions for the hero?

Ava Li: @Marco SVG for web, GIF fallback for email. Hero: 1200x628 (web card), hero banner 1600x400 for landing header. Email tiles: 600x200, 320x180, 480x240. Diagram: vector/PNG + a simplified 600x400 slide version.

Juno Park: Can we also have channel variants? i) social static, ii) social animated loop (6s), iii) slide image for webinar deck. We need messaging variations for each: short hook, 2-line value prop, CTA. I can draft copy.

Priya Menon: Draft copy incoming — keeping it tight. Suggested hooks: "Ship inference at predictable cost" / "Make inference economical at scale" / "Benchmark: Latency vs Cost tradeoffs". Will post as a small PR with exact copy strings.

Marco Reyes: Ok. One question on the diagram: do you want the routing nodes labeled (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) or abstract icons? Labeled helps sales.

Ava Li: Please label them. Add tiny annotations for "latency", "unit cost", "SLA tier" on the arrows. Make sure the icons are brand-compliant.

Brand Review: Quick note — use approved palette v3 (no #FF00AA), headline font = Inter Display, body = Inter. Contrast ratio must be >=4.5:1 for body text. Provide alt text drafts.

DesignOps Bot: Scheduled a design slot for Marco on Mon 9am PST. If you need a rush, we can reprioritize but will need explicit sign-off from PM.

Marco Reyes: Will start comps tonight. ETA for initial pass: Mon 3pm PST. I'll attach a Figma file when ready: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/launch-trajectory-commspack

Ava Li: Perfect — @Priya please drop the copy into the Figma text layer when Marco shares. Also tagging @Brand Review for final compliance sign-off before assets are exported. :thumbsup: 

Priya Menon: Copy uploaded once Marco posts link. Will provide alt text and 2 shorter CTAs for A/B.

Brand Review: We'll run a quick brand sweep and accessibility check once comps are in. Expect feedback within 24 hours of the Figma link.

Ava Li: Thanks team — primary goals: clear launch narrative, assets ready for email & social, and a diagram that sales can reuse in decks. If there are tradeoffs (motion vs accessibility), call them out in comments.

Marco Reyes: Noted. I'll add comment threads per risky element (animated spinner timing, GIF frame rate, color overlays).

DesignOps Bot: Reminder scheduled: deliverable checklist (hero, 3 email tiles, diagram vectors, alt text, export specs). I'll ping again on Tue morning.

Ava Li: Closing the loop — if no objections, I'll lock the copy and the deadline. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
